description:
The world's oldest profession is now a thriving black market economy, with an underground workforce that's just an Internet connection and phone call away. In this full episode special, investigative journalist Mariana van Zeller journeys to Las Vegas, into the heart of the American escort industry, and uncovers the gritty reality behind the supply and demand of high-end sex work.
